Let’s break this down.  

The SVG path has 7 vertices:  
1. (14.18, 74.73)  
2. (7.06, 77.65)  
3. (54.96, 79.97)  
4. (60.67, 46.13)  
5. (44.42, 32.60)  
6. (8.68, 65.69)  
7. (14.18, 74.73) — same as first point (closing the path)  

Counting distinct coordinate pairs:  
(14.18,74.73), (7.06,77.65), (54.96,79.97), (60.67,46.13), (44.42,32.60), (8.68,65.69) — that’s 6 distinct points, plus the last one is a repeat of the first.  

So the shape has 6 vertices → it’s a hexagon.  

Final answer: (C)
